name: Allée du Quotidien — étape 1 · se coucher, s'asseoir, attendre
note: Tiered verb place, one-point perspective down the Allée du Quotidien (half-timbered Alsatian cottages). -er verbs on the LEFT houses, -ir/-re/-oir on the RIGHT. Tiers: street (doorways), balcony (first floor), roof (rarest). Reflexive verbs have their mirror painted inside their box. Forward = far lane; back = near cobbles to the square. No painted text.
